rationale: C1 is an undated agriculture budget speech saying marketing of SHG livestock products to farmers at fair prices will be undertaken with agencies such as TNSRLM. This is a statement of intent; no GO, scheme launch or cattle bank is shown in any extract.

cited.quote: Smart Classrooms and Hi-Tech Laboratories support interactive teaching-learning practices

rationale: C1 reports existing and proposed smart classrooms in some schools, but no official step to convert all classrooms by 2031. C3 and C4 show smart classrooms in a few department schools only. Related activity, not the full commitment.

cited.quote: SIPCOT will establish new industrial parks in industrially backward districts, based on district-specific industrial development plans

rationale: C5 (budget speech, 2026-08-05) announces that SIPCOT will establish new parks in backward districts. This is a budget announcement. C2 of the policy note lists land acquisition for parks generally, but no GO or park launch for backward districts is shown.

cited.quote: waiving the proposed crop loan outstanding amount of Rs.5,932.23 crore

rationale: No extract shows a Rs.15,000 per year two-instalment sowing-season assistance for landowning farm families. C4 is a crop loan waiver, a different scheme for a different benefit; C1 and C2 are about other farm subsidies.

cited.quote: Steps are being taken for leasing out the plots to entrepreneurs for establishing food processing industries.

rationale: Extracts describe general agro-processing clusters, pack houses and export initiatives, but none concerns food processing parks for Kodaikanal chocolates, Nilgiri cheese or mountain honey, or exports to the named regions. Related activity only.

This would provide the common facilities for assembly integration and testing of rocket components and satellites.

rationale: C1 reports an IN-SPACe and TIDCO agreement of 11 June 2026 funding a Space Vehicle Common Technical Facility for assembly, integration and testing, still being established. It is an official step but not yet operational, and subsidised rates for entrepreneurs are not shown.

cited.quote: Determine the tariff for generation, supply, transmission and wheeling of electricity

rationale: C1 and C2 only describe the statutory functions of the electricity regulatory commission. No extract shows a comprehensive tariff study or a tariff rationalisation step. C5 concerns an increase in free electricity units, a different matter.

cited.quote: Construction of Phase-II of the Chennai Metro Rail Project, spanning 118.9 km across three corridors

rationale: C1 (budget speech, 2026-08-05) says Phase-II construction is progressing in full swing and the first 14.64 km stretch is to be commissioned shortly. Work is under way but not complete, and no new step for faster completion is shown.

cited.quote: the District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) is constituted in all the 38 districts

rationale: C2 shows existing district authorities and an Integrated Flood Management Centre constituted on 23.10.2025, before this government took office. No extract shows new integrated disaster offices, flood works in five coastal cities or dedicated heatwave offices.

rationale: C4 (Governor's address, 2026-06-18) states intent to press the Union and mentions a resolution and a legal committee in future tense. No extract shows a formal step demanding 70 percent of GST revenue for states.

rationale: C2 lists general policy priorities on fisheries value chains. No extract shows guidelines issued to eliminate intermediaries between fishermen and merchants. C3 and C5 concern an inter-state fishing dispute committee, a different issue.

rationale: C1 and C2 describe GI tag applications and authorized user registration for various products, but no extract mentions a 'Tamil Iyal' brand or an organic GI-based brand for the listed produce. Related activity only.

rationale: C1 describes existing skill training for Adi Dravidar and Tribal youth including tourism and hospitality, for a narrower group and with no 12-week format or employment guarantee. No extract shows the promised new training classes.
